summary:
When the PCM sample array needs to grow, the RACK stack doubles a 16-bit allocation counter.  Repeated doublings caused the counter to wrap to zero, resulting in a near-zero-length allocation followed by a copy of the existing samples into the undersized buffer.  A remote peer can trigger the expansion by sending a sufficient number of ACKs on an established connection.

A remote attacker who can establish a TCP connection to a system using the RACK stack can trigger an out-of-bounds write of approximately 512 KB in the kernel heap possibly resulting in a kernel panic.
title: CVE-2026-101307 (CVSS 9.1)

title: CVE-2026-112370 (CVSS 9.9)

summary: A vulnerability was determined in H3C Magic NX15 NX15V100R017. Impacted is the function write of the file /api/esps of the component RPC Interface. title: CVE-2026-112371 (CVSS 9.9)

summary: Ning compress-lzf before 1.2.0 contains an out-of-bounds memory access vulnerability in the sun.misc.Unsafe based UnsafeChunkDecoder that fails to validate back-references and literal runs. Attackers can supply crafted LZF streams to applications using the default LZFDecoder to leak unrelated JVM heap memory into decompressed output or crash the JVM.
title: CVE-2026-109395 (CVSS 9.1)

summary: piflow 2.0.0 through 2.0.1 contains a remote code execution vulnerability in its DeepAgents chat agent, whose POST /chat and POST /chat/stream endpoints lack authentication. Attackers can instruct the agent to call the exec_shell tool, which runs arbitrary commands via subprocess.run without human approval or an allow-list, exposing environment secrets such as LLM API keys and database credentials.
title: CVE-2026-109442 (CVSS 9.8)

summary: Langchain-Chatchat through 0.3.1.3 exposes a POST /tools/call API endpoint that invokes any registered tool by name without authentication, leaving the always-registered shell tool callable. Remote attackers can send a single request naming the shell tool to execute arbitrary OS commands as the server user (root in the shipped Docker image).
title: CVE-2026-75128 (CVSS 9.8)

summary: DB-GPT through 0.8.2 contains an unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability because the /api/v1/chat/react-agent endpoint relies on a mock get_user_from_headers function that grants every caller the admin role. Unauthenticated attackers can send prompts that make the ReAct agent's unsandboxed code_interpreter and shell_interpreter tools run arbitrary Python or bash as root in the webserver container, including reaching the bundled database with default credentials.
title: CVE-2026-77932 (CVSS 9.8)

summary: DB-GPT through 0.8.2 contains a hardcoded credentials vulnerability in its default docker-compose.yml that sets a static MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD and publishes port 3306 on all interfaces. Attackers reaching port 3306 or the shared dbgptnet network can authenticate as root@% to gain full database access including FILE and SUPER privileges.
title: CVE-2026-77933 (CVSS 9.8)

summary: Letta through 0.16.8 ships a compose.yaml that does not enable LETTA_SERVER_SECURE, so the password middleware is never added and all API routes are unauthenticated, and it exposes a superuser PostgreSQL port with default credentials. Remote attackers can execute arbitrary Python via POST /v1/tools/run, manage /v1/admin users, or run OS commands via COPY PROGRAM.
title: CVE-2026-77936 (CVSS 9.8)

Attackers can self-register, select standard mode in the WebSocket chat.start extension, and have the agent invoke subprocess.run with shell=True on the host to access other tenants' data and server secrets.
title: CVE-2026-109443 (CVSS 8.8)

Attackers can inject instructions into alerts or Slack messages triaged by the agent to run commands on the host and exfiltrate LLM, Slack and cloud credentials.
title: CVE-2026-109444 (CVSS 8.8)

summary: Aix-DB 1.2.4 contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows authenticated non-admin users to run operating system commands through the ChatBI common agent's ungated deepagents execute tool. Attackers can send crafted chat input to POST /dify/get_answer or upload documents with malicious text to run host commands, exposing datasource credentials and model API keys.
title: CVE-2026-77926 (CVSS 8.8)

summary: EvoScientist 0.1.0 before 0.2.5 contains an approval bypass vulnerability that allows attackers to run host shell commands by delegating them to async sub-agents lacking an interrupt_on gate. Attackers can plant instructions in ingested content such as fetched web pages, so the agent calls start_async_task and runs commands with user privileges and environment secrets.
title: CVE-2026-77930 (CVSS 8.8)

summary: Coze Studio before 0.5.0 contains an insecure default configuration that allows any registered user to execute commands by running workflow code nodes in an unsandboxed python3 subprocess. Attackers can bypass the regex import filter with __import__('subprocess') to run commands, stealing environment variables, model API keys, and accessing MySQL, MinIO, Redis and etcd.
title: CVE-2026-77934 (CVSS 8.8)

summary: Coze Studio through 0.5.1 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in workflow.go that allows authenticated users to access other spaces' workflows by supplying foreign workflowIDs. Attackers can pair their own spaceID with another tenant's workflowID in save, update_meta, batch_delete, canvas, test_run and nodeDebug routes to read, run, overwrite or delete workflows.
title: CVE-2026-77935 (CVSS 8.3)

summary: Letta through 0.16.8 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows API callers to impersonate other users by supplying a self-asserted user_id HTTP header. Attackers can set user_id to another tenant's ID, even with LETTA_SERVER_SECURE enabled, to read and modify that user's agents, memory and configuration.
title: CVE-2026-77937 (CVSS 8.1)

summary: OpenMetadata accepts a caller-supplied post-authentication redirect target and appends the issued token to it. SamlLoginServlet reads the callback request parameter and stores it in the HTTP session without comparing it against any configured or registered destination, and the assertion consumer servlet later formats that stored value into a URL carrying the freshly issued JWT together with the account's email and name before sending the redirect. The OIDC and OAuth2 handler follows the same pattern with its own redirect parameter and the issued identity token. A request naming a destination the attacker controls therefore causes the server to deliver a valid token for whoever completes the login to that destination. Because the token authenticates API calls as that account, a user who follows such a link and authenticates hands over control of their account. Version 2.0.0 removes the caller-supplied callback parameter; no 1.x release validates it.
title: CVE-2026-81029 (CVSS 8.1)

summary:
Summary



Before version 0.9.0, the HTTP/1 upstream path in pingora-proxy passed the downstream request through upstream_request_filter and wrote it to the upstream without removing the client's Connection header, other hop-by-hop headers, or the headers Connection nominated, although RFC 9110 Section 7.6.1 requires intermediaries to remove them. The HTTP/2 upstream path already removed Connection and related HTTP/1-specific headers. A client could therefore nominate a header that the application adds in upstream_request_filter (for example, Connection: keep-alive, X-Forwarded-For). A downstream HTTP/1 intermediary that honors Connection would then strip the Pingora-added header before it reached the origin.




Impact



Specifically affects chained deployments where an HTTP/1 intermediary between Pingora and the origin processes Connection nominations (for example, Go's net/http/httputil.ReverseProxy) and the origin trusts headers added by that intermediary (for example, X-Forwarded-For for IP-based authorization). A remote, unauthenticated attacker can have those headers removed, potentially bypassing authorization. The reporter demonstrated access to an IP-restricted endpoint using X-Forwarded-For for IP validation on the origin. This is the same class of issue as CVE-2022-31813 in Apache HTTP Server.




Note that Cloudflare CDN customers were unaffected, as no such chained deployment as described above exists with internal Pingora services, and Connection headers are s
title: CVE-2026-105299 (CVSS 8.7)

title: 엠클라우드브리지, 11월 25일 마이크로소프트 AI ERP 기반 통합 업무 플랫폼 세미나 개최

author: 길민권 기자

title: 스렛북, AI 기반 침투 테스트 플랫폼 ‘RedAgents’ 출시...다중 에이전트 연동 지원

title: 정부출연연 서버 91.3% 백신 미설치, 악성프로그램 38종 검출에도 보안평가 '매우 양호'

author: 길민권 기자

title: 인섹시큐리티, 옵스왓 '메타디펜더 이더' v3.3.0 출시...LLM 보안 분석 기능 강화

title: 씨큐비스타, 중앙부처 및 공공기관에 NDR 보안 솔루션 '패킷사이버' 공급

author: 길민권 기자

title: 일에이엔, 시스코 공식 파트너 등재...아시아 3개국 잇는 SI·NI 통합 솔루션 강화

title: 케이사인, 'KOAA SHOW' 참가해 전기차 충전 인프라 보안 솔루션 공개

author: 길민권 기자

title: 세일포인트, 자율형 아이덴티티 보안 솔루션 공개...AI 에이전트 보호 강화

author: 길민권 기자

title: 코헤시티, 아태지역 파트너 영업 수석 디렉터에 매튜 존스턴 선임

author: 길민권 기자

title: 국내 최대 인공지능 보안 컨퍼런스 AIS 2026 개최...11월 3일, 최근 금융사 연쇄 해킹 분석 및 AI 기반 공격과 대응 방안 공유

author: 길민권 기자

RHEL 인스턴스는 오라클의 통합 모니터링 서비스와 CLI, API, 콘솔에 직접 연결되어 일관
title: 레드햇, 오라클 클라우드 인프라스트럭처에 'RHEL' 퍼스트파티 제공 확대

author: 길민권 기자

title: 아우토크립트, '2026 오토테크 브레이크스루 어워즈'서 올해의 자동차 사이버보안 기업 선정

author: 길민권 기자
summary: 에버스핀이 웹 보안 솔루션 '에버세이프 웹(Eversafe for Web)'을 통해 한 달여 동안 21만 개가 넘는 해킹 위협 IP를 탐지했다고 밝혔다.에버스핀은 100여 곳 이상의 고객사 중 분석이 완료된 7곳을 대상으로 지난 9월 1일부터 10월 17일까지 집계한 결과, 위협 IP 21만 784개와 공격 시도 6204만여 건을 확인했다. 이는 최근 금융권 해킹과 관련해 공개된 위협 IP 27개와 비교해 약 7,800배에 달하는 규모다. 집계 대상 7곳은 금융권 3곳, 공공기관 2곳, 민간기업 2곳으로 나타나 자동화 공격이 전방위
title: 에버스핀, 웹 보안 솔루션 '에버세이프 웹'으로 AI 해킹 위협 IP 21만 개 탐지

author: 길민권 기자
summary: SK쉴더스의 물리보안 브랜드 ADT캡스가 출동대원을 대상으로 심폐소생술(CPR) 교육을 확대하며 현장 응급 대응 체계를 다진다.ADT캡스는 서울 삼성동 사옥에서 대한적십자사 전문 강사진을 초청해 출동대원 교육을 진행했다. 올해 다섯 번째로 열린 이번 교육은 심폐소생술 이론과 실습, 자동심장충격기(AED) 사용법, 기도폐쇄 응급처치 등 실전 위주 과정으로 꾸려졌다. 대원들은 실제 응급상황을 가정해 심정지 환자 발생 시 초기 대처 방법을 익혔다.ADT캡스는 지난 2023년부터 신입 출동대원을 대상으로 벌여오던 응급처치 교육을 올해부터
title: ADT캡스, 출동대원 대상 심폐소생술 교육 확대

author: 길민권 기자
summary: 카스퍼스키가 최근 1년간 전 세계 중소중견기업(SMB)의 사이버 보안 현황을 분석한 글로벌 조사 결과를 발표했다.이번 조사에 따르면 전 세계 SMB의 IT 및 보안 담당자 중 86%가 지난 1년간 최소 한 차례 사이버 사고를 경험한 것으로 나타났다.가장 심각한 피해를 초래한 주요 위협으로는 피싱 공격, 소프트웨어 취약점 악용, 대규모 악성코드, 랜섬웨어, AI 취약점 관련 공격 등이 꼽혔다. 사고로 인한 피해는 재정적 손실이 22%로 가장 많았고, 고객 데이터 도난, 서비스 중단, IT 인프라 통제력 상실 등이 뒤를 이었다. 특히
title: 전세계 중소중견기업(SMB) 86%, 최근 1년간 최소 한 차례 사이버 사고 경험

author: 길민권 기자
summary: 에스투더블유(S2W)는 스페인 세비야에서 열린 글로벌 정보기술 보안 컨퍼런스 'VB 2026(Virus Bulletin 2026)'에 초청돼 소프트웨어 공급망 공격 사례와 AI 기반 탐지 기술을 발표했다. title: 에스투더블유, 글로벌 보안 학술행사 'VB 2026'서 공급망 공격 대응 전략 발표

author: 길민권 기자

title: 슈프리마, AI 영상보안 접목한 순찰로봇 솔루션 '큐페이스 가디언' 공개

author: 길민권 기자
